headline: ActionAid Report Finds Agroecology Can Raise Kenyan Farmer Profits
summary: An ActionAid report found that Kenyan farmers could increase their profits by an average of 37.8 percent by adopting agroecological farming practices.
why: Sustainable agricultural practice studies highlight input cost reductions for synthetic fertilizers and pesticides, affecting farm enterprise profitability.

impacts.name: Agriculture
impacts.why: Reducing expenditure on synthetic inputs improves net margins for smallholder farming enterprises.
